description: This file contains database migration functions and related logic for the Focalboard project, including handling block IDs, category deduplication, and collation fixes.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer for Focalboard, containing methods for database migrations and data integrity.

methods.name: getBlocksWithSameID
methods.description: Retrieves blocks with duplicate IDs from the database.

methods.name: RunUniqueIDsMigration
methods.description: Performs migration to ensure all blocks have unique IDs.

methods.name: RunCategoryUUIDIDMigration
methods.description: Migrates categories based on board and membership data, preserving UUIDs.

methods.name: RunFixCollationsAndCharsetsMigration
methods.description: Fixes table collation and charset mismatches for MySQL databases.

methods.name: getFocalBoardTableNames
methods.description: Fetches all table names related to Focalboard in the database.

methods.name: getCollationAndCharset
methods.description: Retrieves collation and charset information for a specific table.

methods.name: RunDeDuplicateCategoryBoardsMigration
methods.description: Deduplicates entries in the category_boards table, supporting MySQL and PostgreSQL.

methods.name: doesDuplicateCategoryBoardsExist
methods.description: Checks if duplicate category_board entries exist.

methods.name: runMySQLDeDuplicateCategoryBoardsMigration
methods.description: Executes deduplication in MySQL for category_boards.

methods.name: runPostgresDeDuplicateCategoryBoardsMigration
methods.description: Executes deduplication in PostgreSQL for category_boards.
